heading: A Pocketful of Play
subheading: A growing assortment of challenge and distraction
welcomeMessage: I know the pressure can get loud in there sometimes, not to mention the meetings that could've been messages, the never-ending to-dos to do, all of it. Sometimes you need five minutes away but you don't want to doom-scroll. This is where you can give yourself a refreshing lime soda or a relaxing hot chocolate, for the mind before your next meeting.
instructions: • A comfortable seat (optimal for heavy thinking)
• A soft kitty to pet (or annoy)
• The perfect playlist (in your ears or your head)
• A warm cup of matcha (or coffee)
